name: M3_MMS200MI_CpyItmFac
description: Create a new item–facility connection by copying an existing item that is already connected to a facility. The operation links an item to a specific facility (and company) and uses another item–facility combination as a template, so facility‑level parameters such as lead times, planning rules, costing models, customs and environment groups, supply settings, and quality/inspection controls are inherited. This simplifies rolling out items across additional facilities and helps ensure consistent planning and costing behavior between facilities.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility to which the item will be connected when copying from another facility.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number to create or update at the target facility.

inputParameters.name: CFAC
inputParameters.description: Facility from which the existing item/facility data will be copied.

inputParameters.name: CITN
inputParameters.description: Item number in the source facility whose facility settings are copied.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company for which the new item/facility record is created.

inputParameters.name: LEA4
inputParameters.description: Administrative lead time in days added to the item’s total lead time at the facility.

inputParameters.name: CSNO
inputParameters.description: Customs statistical number used for trade statistics for the item at this facility.

inputParameters.name: SPFA
inputParameters.description: Conversion factor used to convert quantities to the supplementary unit of measure for trade statistics.

inputParameters.name: ORCO
inputParameters.description: Country of origin for the item at the facility.

inputParameters.name: APPR
inputParameters.description: Average inventory cost per item at the facility in local currency.

inputParameters.name: UCOS
inputParameters.description: Standard cost for the item at the facility (deprecated and not used in current versions).

inputParameters.name: SOCO
inputParameters.description: Fixed ordering cost per order for the item at the facility.

inputParameters.name: EXPC
inputParameters.description: Theoretical yield percentage used for planning and costing of the item at the facility.

inputParameters.name: BQTY
inputParameters.description: Standard batch quantity used when planning production of the item at the facility.

inputParameters.name: BQTM
inputParameters.description: Method used to determine the batch quantity for the item at the facility.

inputParameters.name: LLCM
inputParameters.description: Lowest bill-of-material level at which the item can appear in product structures.

inputParameters.name: DLET

inputParameters.name: DLEF

inputParameters.name: DIDY
inputParameters.description: Controls whether the item is planned as a flow order within the defined flow order fence.

inputParameters.name: DIDF
inputParameters.description: Number of days defining the fence within which manufacturing orders are treated as flow orders.

inputParameters.name: PRRA
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether production rate-based planning is activated for the item at the facility.

inputParameters.name: TRHC
inputParameters.description: Daily throughput rate of available capacity used when planning the item at the facility.

inputParameters.name: MARC
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the item is reserved specifically for manufacturing orders at the facility.

inputParameters.name: JITF
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the item is produced and delivered without manufacturing orders.

inputParameters.name: REWH

inputParameters.name: OPFQ

inputParameters.name: FANO
inputParameters.description: On-hand balance for the facility accumulated according to the selected method (deprecated field).

inputParameters.name: FANQ
inputParameters.description: On-hand balance under inspection for the facility (deprecated field).

inputParameters.name: FANR

inputParameters.name: FATM
inputParameters.description: Method used to accumulate on-hand balances at facility level.

inputParameters.name: WCLN
inputParameters.description: Production line where the item is normally manufactured.

inputParameters.name: EDEC
inputParameters.description: Method used to control excess stock based on expiry dates for the item at the facility.

inputParameters.name: AUGE
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether manufacturing orders are created automatically after customer order entry for the item.

inputParameters.name: ECCC
inputParameters.description: Consumption code used for trade statistics for this item.

inputParameters.name: ECAR

inputParameters.name: CPRI

inputParameters.name: CPRE

inputParameters.name: WSCA

inputParameters.name: PRCM

inputParameters.name: PLAP

inputParameters.name: PLUP

inputParameters.name: SCMO

inputParameters.name: CPL1

inputParameters.name: CPL2

inputParameters.name: PPL0

inputParameters.name: PPL1

inputParameters.name: PPL2

inputParameters.name: TXID

inputParameters.name: DTID

inputParameters.name: CPDC

inputParameters.name: EVGR

inputParameters.name: MOLL

inputParameters.name: CPUN

inputParameters.name: COFA

inputParameters.name: ALTS

inputParameters.name: SQCO
